sentences.text: So these are astronaut boot prints on the Moon, from over fifty years ago.
On Earth, wind and rain would wipe them out fast.
But the Moon has no air, so no wind and no rain.
The only thing wearing them down is a slow drizzle of tiny space rocks.
Scientists think the prints could last tens of thousands of years, maybe much longer.
So for now, they're just sitting there, waiting.
